text: This report provides a high-level overview of development on the Exhibition Place grounds over the past 60 years, including the implementation of the strategy of adaptive re-use of existing structures. This strategy has supported the rehabilitation and preservation of heritage properties as well as an increase in the number of events held annually at Exhibition Place.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Received the report (August 30, 2024) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place for information.
